stories.title: At least 13 killed in Ukrainian drone strike deep into Russia
stories.body: Russian officials say another 75 people were injured by the attack - one of the deadliest Ukrainian drone attacks since Moscow's full-scale invasion.

stories.title: World's oceans hit record-high July temperatures
stories.body: Global oceans recorded their hottest July on record, partly fuelled by developing El Niño conditions, as wildfires continue to ravage western Europe.

stories.title: Netanyahu's rejection of Trump's 15-point Gaza plan unlikely to be final word
stories.body: The Trump administration is said to be unbothered by the Israeli prime minister's rejection of the deal, viewing it as campaign rhetoric ahead of a general election.

stories.title: 'We've had a lot of close calls': Canada wildfire evacuees wonder if they still have homes
stories.body: More than 12,000 people have been forced to evacuate and some homes have been lost after a wildfire tore through Canada's picturesque Okanagan region.

stories.title: 30 years later, a former gang member will stand trial for Tupac's murder
stories.body: It’s been three decades since Tupac was killed, and since then, his reputation has only grown.

stories.title: We are chasing Ebola virus - it is ahead of us, WHO warns
stories.body: Infection rates are high, adding to concern that authorities are struggling to get to grips with the disease.

stories.title: Trump signs order to limit childhood vaccines and split MMR shots
stories.body: The Trump administration recommends separating the measles, mumps and rubella vaccine into three different shots administered in separate visits.

stories.title: New train service connects Finland and Sweden for first time in decades
stories.body: The service will enable rail travel from Portugal to Lapland - what is believed to be the longest train journey in Europe.

stories.title: Russian court bars only anti-war party from standing in parliamentary elections
stories.body: Russia's only liberal, anti-war party will not be able to take part in next month's parliamentary elections, a Moscow court rules.

stories.title: Evidence that South African special forces murdered top detective shared with BBC
stories.body: Frans Mathipa was shot while driving - we got access to the prosecution case against eight accused men.

stories.title: Former Thai MP allegedly kills official and confesses on YouTube
stories.body: Chalong Riewrang called a YouTube livestream to say he had shot a government official.

stories.title: Hundreds arrested over French wildfires, but who is to blame?
stories.body: The government is trying to attribute blame for the unprecedented fires which tore through the country last month.

stories.title: Australia is the planet's extinction hotspot, but one animal offers a glimmer of hope
stories.body: The country is home to some of the world's most unique species - but it is losing them at an alarming rate.

stories.title: How a schoolteacher's son became Kashmir's first India Test cricketer
stories.body: Auqib Nabi becomes Jammu and Kashmir's first cricketer to get India Test call-up, inspiring millions.

stories.title: Nigeria's mass wedding - and how telling lovers from fraudsters is proving tricky
stories.body: The scheme is for couples who cannot afford the significant financial costs associated with marriage.

stories.title: Watch: What we know about suspected crime boss Daniel Kinahan
stories.body: Suspected crime boss Daniel Kinahan, one of the world's most wanted men, has spent his first night in custody in Ireland after being extradited from Dubai.

stories.title: How Kinahan's hearing unfolded inside the courtroom in Dublin
stories.body: Suspected crime boss Daniel Kinahan appeared in court and was charged with directing the activities of a criminal organisation after being extradited from Dubai.

stories.title: Watch: Moment opposition MP throws eggs at Kosovo's acting PM
stories.body: Lawmakers and police officers had to intervene after Alliance party MP Time Kadrijaj hurled at least four eggs towards Kosovo's acting prime minister Albin Kurti.

stories.title: Watch: BBC asks Infantino if he will resign as Fifa president
stories.body: The head of the football governing body has faced multiple calls to quit after his aborted attempt to sell private stakes in the World Cup.

stories.title: Russia bars only party opposing war in Ukraine from parliamentary vote
stories.body: The pro-Kremlin nationalist party Rodina accused the Yabloko party of receiving undeclared campaign support.
